title: The generic HDF5 representation of a ResultBundle
note: H1-H8: each disagreement between the structured view, the record, the stated digest and the artefact bytes is refused; authority is never claimed.

mutations.name: H1_value_unchecked
mutations.rationale: an output value edited in the structured view reads back as the record

mutations.name: H2_attrs_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a changed unit or resolution attribute passes

mutations.name: H3_digest_unchecked
mutations.rationale: a rewritten record passes as the stated bundle

mutations.name: H4_raw_artifact_unchecked
mutations.rationale: artefact bytes not their digest pass

mutations.name: H5_authority_claim_accepted
mutations.rationale: a file claiming authority is read

mutations.name: H8_write_accepts_wrong_bytes
mutations.find:
if digest_bytes(raw) != refs[name].digest or \
                len(raw) != refs[name].size_bytes:
mutations.rationale: bytes the bundle does not cite are written as its artefact
